title: Who is asking, and which call
description: What the hub puts in a tools/call request's _meta: who asked, so the agent's log of every call says so, and an id for the call, so a call sent twice is run once.

claude-voice/caller.description: voice for the voice, or the name of the Claude Code session that asked through the hub.

claude-voice/call_id.description: New and random for each call the voice or a session makes. The hub sends the same id again only when it sends the same call again. An agent refuses an id it has already run, with code duplicate_call.
